evaluated_knowledge_units.title: Real-Time Accessible Live Region & Dynamic Cognitive Feedback
DOM Edge Regex Sanitization on Streaming Binary Protocols

compatibility_pairs.justification: Edge sanitization masks confidential data while dynamic accessible live regions reduce operator hesitation. The two operate on complementary layers of the input lifecycle without data schema collisions.
NEG-BKM-001 prohibits DOM regex parsing on streaming binary protocols. Combining these causes 400% latency bloat and thread starvation.
